diagramProperties.title: Diagram properties
diagramProperties.appearanceThemesHint: Edits below affect this diagram only. Apply a saved theme, or manage themes in Settings.
diagramProperties.backgroundImageTooLarge: Image is too large (max about 1.5 MB).
diagramProperties.backgroundImageInvalid: Could not use that image file.
diagramProperties.fontMissing: The font “{{font}}” is not available on this device. Choose it from installed fonts above. Diagram files only store the font name, not the font file itself.
diagramProperties.customFontHint: Custom fonts must be installed on this device. They are not saved inside diagram files.
diagramProperties.uiFontHint: Diagram font applies to canvas labels only. The application interface keeps its default font.

appSettings.title: Settings
appSettings.themeHint: Affects the application interface only, not diagram colours.
appSettings.customThemesHint: Import a theme JSON file to use a custom colour scheme without rebuilding the app. Export the active theme as a starting point.
appSettings.themeImportInvalid: That file is not a valid theme (schemaVersion 1 with id, name, and tokens).
appSettings.diagramThemeHint: Default colours for new diagrams. Edit named themes under Diagram Themes.
appSettings.diagramThemeApplyConfirm: Apply the selected diagram theme to the current diagram? This overwrites the current appearance settings.
appSettings.diagramThemesLibraryHint: Create and edit named diagram themes. Colour editors below always show the selected theme (including Default). Changing Default saves your edits as a new custom theme.
appSettings.diagramThemeImportInvalid: That file is not a valid diagram theme (schemaVersion 1 with id, name, and appearance).
appSettings.themeEditorHint: Edit a custom theme. Changes preview live in the interface. Light and Dark built-in themes cannot be overwritten — create a custom theme from them instead.
appSettings.themeEditorEmptyHint: Create a custom theme to start editing colours. Built-in Light and Dark themes stay unchanged.
appSettings.themeEditorUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save to keep them, or Revert to discard the draft.
appSettings.themeEditorFontHint: UI font for the application chrome. Custom fonts fall back to Arial if unavailable. Diagram text uses Diagram properties → Font.
appSettings.languageHint: Affects the application interface, not text inside your diagram.
appSettings.selectionPulseEnabledHint: Show a soft pulsing highlight on selected characters, boxes, and lines in their border or line colour. Automatically disabled when your system prefers reduced motion.
appSettings.lineLabelContrastWithBackgroundHint: By default, line label text matches the line colour. Enable this to use dark or light text that contrasts with the label background instead, which can be easier to read.
appSettings.autosaveHint: Automatically saves your diagram locally and restores it when you reopen the app.
appSettings.confirmBeforeNew: Confirm before starting a new diagram
appSettings.exportHint: Default values when opening the export dialog.
appSettings.defaultExportDirectoryHint: When set, the PNG export dialog opens in this folder.
appSettings.defaultDiagramDirectoryHint: When set, save and open dialogs start in this folder.
appSettings.defaultFolderDesktopOnly: Default folders can only be set in the desktop app.
appSettings.clearAutosaveHint: Clears the locally saved autosave used for restoring work after reopening the app. It does not delete the diagram currently open on screen or any files you have saved manually.
appSettings.clearAutosaveConfirm: Delete the locally saved autosave? Your current diagram on screen is not affected.

diagramAppearance.canvasSetupHint: Background is part of the selected diagram theme. Font and header defaults below apply when you create a new diagram.
diagramAppearance.headerChromeHint: Header pill colours apply to the diagram title and subtitle on this diagram immediately.
diagramAppearance.characterNewHint: Border colour applies only to newly created characters.
diagramAppearance.characterPlaceholderHint: Placeholder fill and initials apply to all characters without an image on this diagram immediately.
diagramAppearance.lineNewHint: Line colour applies only to newly created lines.
diagramAppearance.boxNewHint: Box colour applies only to newly created boxes.
diagramAppearance.textNewHint: Text colour applies only to newly created floating text.
diagramAppearance.labelChromeHint: Label colours apply to all matching labels on this diagram immediately.
diagramAppearance.lineLabelTextHint: Line label text matches each line's colour by default. An accessibility setting can switch it to high-contrast text against the label background instead.
diagramAppearance.themeSelectedDefaultHint: Default itself cannot be overwritten. You can inspect its colours below; the first change will save your edits as a new custom theme.
diagramAppearance.themeSelectedCustomHint: Editing “{{name}}”. Colour changes below update the draft; Save theme to keep them.
diagramAppearance.themeForkFromDefaultHint: Default cannot be overwritten. Name a custom theme to keep these colour changes.
diagramAppearance.themeAppliedFeedback: Applied theme to the current diagram.
diagramAppearance.themeImportInvalid: That file is not a valid diagram theme (schemaVersion 1 with id, name, and appearance).
